strings.en: So you're saying that red machine is how you got back to the surface?
Most likely...
So does that mean the Einst sent us flying to Byston Well, too?
Were they trying to trap us in another world...?
The red machine's pilot said they'd brought some extra baggage along...
They probably meant to return to the surface by themselves,
but for some reason, we got dragged along too...
In Byston Well, we people from the surface
are called Holy Warriors.
With so many surface people like us there, the Aura Road
may have become easier to open.
There's still so much we don't know about that enemy.
Did anything happen on the surface while we were in the other world?
A lot happened, but the big news is that we destroyed the Devil Gundam.
You were short on fighters without us, and you still beat it?
Thanks to Domon.
Domon?
Meikyo Shisui... Maybe it's something we just can't understand...
Wow, so Domon finally beat the Devil Gundam!
For now, I suppose things have settled down...
This place really is the most comfortable, huh, Lenny?
Yeah. The Goraon was nice, but the Elshank feels more like home.
I'm so glad you came back safely... Joe.
Hey! I'm here too, you know?
Man, I was wondering what we'd do if we couldn't get back. Right, Lenny?
Oh please, you were the one saying you liked it and could live there.
If only he had. It would've been a load off my mind.
Heh, too bad for you, Gamey.
Were there any ninja in Byston Well, Joe?
Nah, not among the people we met, but...
But what?
Tobikage came to help us in that world, too.
Really? That Tobikage sure shows up everywhere.
So Schwarz is still our only lead on the ninja...
Where is Schwarz now?
Who knows. Isn't he with Domon Kasshu and the others?
Still... it bugs me.
...He took a beating shielding the Shining Gundam, you know?
Yes. ...I wonder if he's all right.
...Yes, I understand. I'll tell Domon that too. Goodbye.
What about Father!? What's happened to him?
They'll lift his cryo-sentence once the Devil Gundam is recovered...
I see... Thank goodness...
So that takes care of our original goal, but...
Yeah. There's nothing left for me here.
Hey, Domon! Don't tell me you're saying goodbye here!
...I know, Allenby.
Then you'll stay with the Gandor Team, Domon?
We beat the Devil Gundam, but Master's surely still scheming.
I see. Then this is good timing.
Good timing for what?
Father is developing a new Gundam for Domon.
A new Gundam?
It has an enhanced emotion energy system, and a multiplier that turns ki
into energy. It's truly a machine worthy of being the Shining Gundam's
successor.
If that new power is combined with my Meikyo Shisui...
But he said it'll still take time to complete.
Lucky. I wish they'd power up my Nobel, too.
Hey. Come to think of it... where's that man?
Schwarz? He left a moment ago without a word.
I see...
(The damage he took shielding me...
he shouldn't have been able to move so soon...
Schwarz Bruder... who in the world is he?)
...Absurd! You want me to do that to my... my Apsaras!?
Yours or mine, it makes no difference.
These are Lady Haman's orders. You have no right to refuse,
Technical Major General Ginias Sahalin.
Lady Haman... But... that's absurd...!
You understand, don't you? The operation is entering its final phase.
We're already being hindered by those incomprehensible invaders.
If that Gandor Team comes up here, it'll be a real nuisance.
...Under... stood. Tell Lady Haman that...!
My, my, you look pale. Well, do your best, then.
And try not to get that cute little girl pilot killed by mistake.
Right, Technical Major General? Heh heh heh...
Ngh... Grr...!
Brother...? That transmission just now...
The complete Apsaras will take a while longer to finish...!
All we have are a few prototypes...
Brother, I... can't anymore...
...Aina... We're launching the Apsaras...
...!! What on earth has happened, Brother?
A colony... is going to fall on Earth...!
Lady Aina... may I have a moment?
Norris...
So that thing... appears to be complete.
I am a bit troubled by where its backing came from, though...
It hasn't even had a test run yet.
I almost wish... it would never be finished.
Lady Aina. Why is it that you came here?
Would it be strange if I said... for my brother's dream?
Not at all.
Once Brother's Apsaras is complete, the flames of this war will die down.
But... it's still a weapon that will take countless lives...
It is for the Sahalin family. My life will remain with the Sahalin family.
Thank you... Norris.
Pride, honor, bloodline, me as a Sahalin... I'm just like a doll...
Lady Aina...
It's all right... Norris... I'm fine.
...It seems you sent the surviving soldiers off to Lady Haman.
I'm surprised your brother, Lord Ginias, agreed to it.
...The condition: I take the Space Science Lab with the prototype.
...What...! Lady Aina... I will follow you anywhere. But...
I can't let the soldiers die along with my brother's obsession...
Lady Aina...
You've grown strong. Is it... because of love?
You wound me. I wasn't born from a tree trunk, you know.
Not before I chose the path of a career soldier, anyway...
I know nothing... about Norris, who was like a parent to me...
I...? Lady Aina's... parent...!?
I'm honored...! My mind is made up... I'm heading out!
Norris!?
A person's life... is measured by what they accomplish.
Lord Ginias achieved his dream... That is admirable.
If Lady Aina wishes to seize the lab, helping her is my duty as a soldier.
...Norris!
Please... come along a little later.
I'll go ahead, seize the laboratory, and be there to greet you.
Impossible... A colony!?
Bright, what's going on!?
These days a colony drop should be detected early on!
...We were set up. By the Delaz Fleet!
We're moving now to stop the colony from falling. There's no time.
Captain Bright! Where's the projected impact point!?
Most likely... Jaburo.
Haman can't be happy that an unknown army has taken it, either.
Sure, we'd be safe if we just stayed here in Japan...
but all we can do is sit and watch...!
Dropping a colony!? What the hell are they thinking...!
Commander Hazuki, can't we stop it from our end!?
...Impossible. An HLV won't make it before the point of no return...!
Then how about going straight there in the Gandor?
Hold on, look at the state the surface is in.
If the Gandor goes off into space...
...Right, that's no good.
Besides... if we push it, the dragon's life would...
Dammit, we just have to leave it to Londo Bell!?
Grendizer can reach space on its own. At least I can go...
Daisuke, I'm going to space with you.
No, Koji!
She's right. If you go up into space too,
then who's going to protect this green earth, Koji?
"How green was my land"... right?
How do you know that...?
Koji said it once before...
Heh heh.
Like all of you, I want to protect this beautiful Earth.
Princess Romina...?
Please use the Elshank...
We will take Daisuke and his sister to Londo Bell.
Our Elshank has a warp drive called Microworm Navigation.
With it, we should make it in time... However...
You mean the fuel. You needn't worry about that.
Major Ronin should be delivering Kirhasium to the Space Science Lab
any time now.
That Ronin, he really comes through...!
With the Elshank's Microworm Navigation, we can soon join up
with this Londo Bell of yours right away.
Are you sure, Princess Romina?
Yes, if it will help you all...
Princess Romina... thank you.
Thank you.
...How lucky I am... watched over by so many friends from other worlds.
Then, Captain Bright...
We're grateful... We'll contact you later about the rendezvous point.
We'll head for the Space Science Laboratory at once, too. Until then...
We can't leave the surface.
Can we really do nothing but watch...!?
Grendizer can reach space on its own...
At least I can go to space.
Brother, I'm going back to Londo Bell too. I only came down on a whim.
But Aphrodite A can't break through the atmosphere alone, can it?
Please use the Elshank...
Princess...?
We appreciate the offer, but you could never make it in time now.
Leave this to us...
No, the Elshank has Microworm Navigation...
what you would call a warp device. With that...
But Princess, to use Microworm Navigation, we need Kirhasium...
The fuel won't be a problem. Major Ronin should be
bringing it to the Space Science Laboratory any time now.
That Ronin, he really comes through...!
Then let us hurry to this Space Science Laboratory...
Are you sure, Princess Romina?
Yes, if it will help you all...
Princess Romina... thank you.
Thanks. ...How lucky I am, watched over by friends from other worlds.
Then, Captain Bright...
We're grateful.
But... they say the area right around the colony is a war zone.
If you go waltzing out there, you'll just be in danger, you know?
...Are you worried about me, Joe?
Uh, w-well, yeah.
But the Elshank alone...
I'll go.
Whoa, whoa, Akira, it's outer space, you know?
Like Daisuke said, the Einst are showing up in space too, right?
Raideen might be able to figure something out.
Hmm. Yes. Losing more of our strength here hurts, but...
this is no time to worry about that.
All right, the Gandor Team will now head for the Space Science Lab!
Get me Director Umon!
Space, huh. ...The Einst are said to be appearing in space too...
I'd like to see it with my own eyes, but...
